changes_vs_current: New topic. Raw average-position order (6 people sources) was Coca-Cola, Sprite, Dr Pepper, Pepsi, Mountain Dew, 7UP, A&W, Canada Dry, Fanta, Diet Coke...

Pepsi moved from #4 to #2: it is #2 in YouGov purchase consideration (27%) and #3 in YouGov fame, and is the obvious second answer; Sprite's raw #2 is inflated by YouGov's liking score. Sprite #4 and Dr Pepper #3 still match 2024 sales (#3/#2).
Coke Zero (#15) and Diet Pepsi (#19) left below #12 despite gut check: YouGov popularity puts them at 20th and 23rd of sodas (45% and 40% positive), offsetting their #7/#8 sales rank.

Diet Coke moved from #10 to #6 (7UP, A&W, Canada Dry, Fanta each shift down one) at coordinator request: it is the #5 brand by 2024 Beverage Digest sales and #4 in YouGov fame (98%), and it is a staple answer. Counter-evidence noted: YouGov popularity ranks it 18th of sodas (47%) because diet drinkers are a loyal minority, and it won no state in the Google Trends study, whereas Canada Dry, Fanta, A&W and 7UP each won at least one.

Cherry Coke moved into #20 (raw #29) on Ranker crowd vote #8; it is a very commonly typed answer and no source places it below the remaining candidates. Squirt, Starry/Sierra Mist, Fresca, Pibb Xtra, Sun Drop dropped out (raw #24-28).
Root beer and ginger ale generics assigned to the category leaders: 'root beer' -> A&W, 'ginger ale' -> Canada Dry, 'cream soda' -> A&W Cream Soda.
confidence: medium: top 5 (Coke, Pepsi, Dr Pepper, Sprite, Mountain Dew) are solid across sales, YouGov and search data, but there is no direct national 'favorite soda' poll with full percentages, so mid-list order between 7UP/A&W/Canada Dry/Fanta/diet brands rests on YouGov liking vs sales tradeoffs.
